text: PR No./Message by the Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar@MIshaqDar50on World Humanitarian Day (19 August 2026)
translated_text: PR 号/副总理/外交部长参议员 Mohammad Ishaq Dar@MIshaqDar50 世界人道主义日致辞（2026 年 8 月 19 日）

text:
Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif's Message on World Humanitarian Day 19 August 2026.

On World Humanitarian Day, Pakistan joins the international community in reaffirming its commitment to the noble values of humanitarian service, compassion, human dignity and solidarity.
translated_text:
总理穆罕默德·谢赫巴兹·谢里夫于 2026 年 8 月 19 日世界人道主义日致辞。

值此世界人道主义日，巴基斯坦与国际社会一起重申其对人道主义服务、同情心、人类尊严和团结等崇高价值观的承诺。

text: Journalism begins with some very basic rules: check your facts, provide context, separate evidence from assumption and, principally, don’t decide the verdict first and then go shopping for material to support it later. That’s not journalism; that’s propaganda. Big difference.
translated_text: 新闻从一些非常基本的规则开始：检查你的事实，提供背景，将证据与假设分开，原则上不要先做出结论，然后再去购买材料来支持它。这不是新闻业；而是新闻业。这就是宣传。差别很大。
